jurisdiction.venue: SEBI, SAT, Reserve Bank of India (RBI) & SFIO

headline: Before Telling Shareholders About a $230 Million Hole, Bank Chiefs Found Time to Sell
deck: SEBI froze ₹19.78 crore in alleged avoided losses by former IndusInd Bank leaders Sumant Kathpalia, Arun Khurana and three colleagues after a ₹2,000 crore FX-derivatives discrepancy triggered a 27 percent stock plunge.
byline: By The Financial Crimes Mumbai Bureau

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: Executive resignations, ESOP clawbacks, and ₹19.78 Cr frozen under SEBI’s May 2025 interim order; SAT appeals and SFIO inquiries active.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Selling a wrecked car for $1,800 after hiding an inspection report
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Immediate consumer-fraud charges without multi-year appellate stays
